cases.name: Result argument to void
cases.body: function take(cb: () => void): void { cb() } function f() { take(read) }

cases.name: Result object callback
cases.body: const handlers: { run(): void } = { run: read };

cases.name: Result generic callback
cases.body: function identity<T>(v: T): T { return v } const callback = identity<() => void>(read);

cases.name: native Promise executor discards Results
cases.body: async function f() { await new Promise<void>((resolve): Result<void, Bad> => { resolve(); return }) }

cases.name: Promise object callback
cases.body: const handlers: { run(): void } = { run: work };

cases.name: Promise fulfillment Result erasure
cases.body: async function get(): Promise<Result<number, Bad>> { return read()! } const callback: () => Promise<unknown> = get;

cases.name: class implementation erases Result
cases.body: interface I { run(): void } class C implements I { run(): Result<number, Bad> { return read() } }

cases.name: class override erases Promise
cases.body: class Base { run(): void {} } class Sub extends Base { async run(): Promise<number> { return 1 } }

cases.name: higher-order return erasure
cases.body: function consume(f: () => void): void { f() } const cb: (f: () => Result<number, Bad>) => void = consume;

cases.name: Result consumer owns the completion
cases.body: function take(cb: () => Result<number, Bad>): boolean { return cb().isError() } function f(): boolean { return take(read) }

cases.name: Promise fulfillment Result preserved
cases.body: async function get(): Promise<Result<number, Bad>> { return read()! } const callback: () => Promise<Result<number, Bad>> = get;

cases.name: pure callback may satisfy a void contract
cases.body: function consume(f: () => void): void { f() } const cb: (f: () => number) => void = consume;

cases.name: async Result observer joins Promise
cases.body: async function f(): Promise<boolean> { return (await read().tapAsync(work)).isError() }

cases.name: async Result record observers join Promise
cases.body: async function f(): Promise<boolean> { return (await read().tapBothAsync({ ok: work, error: work })).isError() }
